plans.rationale: Option 1 supplies a coherent five-section topical structure, keeps principal targets and replies together, and preserves every accepted bridge through assigned evidence. Its weights appropriately recognize cosmology as the broadest exchange while giving substantial structural weight to the motion-level rival-hypothesis and religious-experience discussion; the compact resurrection exchange receives a correspondingly narrower share. Its importance assignments also recognize the distinct load-bearing causal, personal-creator, fine-tuning, moral, resurrection, experiential, and skeptical-burden moves without creating a catch-all section.
